field_text_formatted.value: Changing a pattern doesn't touch anything you've already uploaded. New files follow it, old ones stay put until you ask, either with Retroactive update on the field or drush filefield_paths:update. Do that on a copy first. It moves every file at once, and it'll break links to them unless Create Redirect is on, which wants the Redirect module.
